training_labels: Inherited two-source primary categories; category_id1..5 only in type CE; no WildGuard type supervision
loss: Five-way cross entropy on the existing harmful subset
checkpoint_selection: minimum validation harmful-subset CE; stop after 8 epochs without >=1e-4 improvement; maximum40
primary_contrast: description_queries versus exactly equal-parameter learned_queries; both versus near-equal-parameter MLP
end_to_end_metrics: Six classes0..5 on the same two-source test subset after unchanged parent binary gate
binary_gate: Frozen E04 and existing validation-selected threshold; safe gate yields category0
input: Full Chinese text; original split membership; no augmentation or truncation
feature_reuse: One frozen E04 full-text last-layer cache shared by every head and seed
limitations: Inherited source labels are not newly reviewed human gold.
JailBench domains and formal national-standard clauses are not identical, especially class5.
Existing split identities have been explored; not a fresh blind test.
MLP705655 and query706177 parameters differ by522(0.074%); query variants exactly matched.
Attention weights are aggregation weights, not validated causal explanations.
Backbone and LoRA were trained for binary detection and remain frozen during type-head training.
binary_training: Existing three-source E04 backbone/LoRA/binary head frozen; binary training is not rerun
comparisons_to_older_results: No direct improvement claim against old three-source or8k test metrics; different test populations
